item.title: Amgen says drug combo cuts risk of death by 58% in patients with aggressive lung cancer
item.description: A drug from Amgen could give patients with an aggressive form of lung cancer significantly more time to live when added to an immunotherapy from AstraZeneca.

item.title: Democrats, voting-rights groups challenge Trump's bid to block Alaska Senate certification
item.description: Lawsuits filed by candidate Mary Peltola and a voters' rights group challenge Trump's preemptive efforts to block a Democratic Senate victory in Alaska.

item.title: Why popular airplanes are getting scrapped years early
item.description: Airplanes are getting dismantled for parts years ahead of schedule because engines and other components are in short supply.
